$provenance.note: Derived from the installed Hermes command registry; regenerate after Hermes updates. availability: native (WebUI), hermes (runs in Hermes through the dashboard websocket), unsupported (terminal-only).

commands.name: /settings
commands.description: Open the WebUI Settings workspace

commands.name: /new
commands.description: Start a new session (fresh session ID + history) (usage: /new [name])

commands.name: /reset
commands.description: Start a new session (fresh session ID + history) (alias for /new)

commands.name: /clear
commands.description: Clear screen and start a new session

commands.name: /redraw
commands.description: Force a full UI repaint (recovers from terminal drift)
commands.disabledReason: Redraws the terminal screen; the WebUI repaints itself.

commands.name: /history
commands.description: Show conversation history

commands.name: /save
commands.description: Export the current conversation (bare /save shows usage) (usage: /save <json|md|html> [filename] [redact])

commands.name: /retry
commands.description: Retry the last message (resend to agent)

commands.name: /prompt
commands.description: Compose your next prompt in $EDITOR (markdown), then send it (usage: /prompt [initial text])

commands.name: /compose
commands.description: Compose your next prompt in $EDITOR (markdown), then send it (alias for /prompt)
commands.disabledReason: Opens your terminal editor; type in the composer instead (Shift+Enter for new lines).

commands.name: /undo
commands.description: Back up N user turns and re-prompt (default 1) (usage: /undo [N])

commands.name: /title
commands.description: Set a title for the current session (usage: /title [name])

commands.name: /handoff
commands.description: Hand off this session to a messaging platform (Telegram, Discord, etc.) (usage: /handoff <platform>)

commands.name: /branch
commands.description: Branch the current session (explore a different path) (usage: /branch [name])

commands.name: /fork
commands.description: Branch the current session (explore a different path) (alias for /branch)

commands.name: /worktree
commands.description: Show, list, create, or prune isolated git worktrees (usage: /worktree [new [name]|list|prune [--dry-run]])

commands.name: /compress
commands.description: Compress conversation context (add 'here [N]' to keep recent N turns; --preview shows what would happen) (usage: /compress [here [N] | focus topic | --preview|--dry-run])

commands.name: /compact
commands.description: Compress conversation context (add 'here [N]' to keep recent N turns; --preview shows what would happen) (alias for /compress)

commands.name: /rollback
commands.description: List or restore filesystem checkpoints (restores keep your hand-edits; --all overrides) (usage: /rollback [number] [--all])

commands.name: /snapshot
commands.description: Create or restore state snapshots of Hermes config/state (usage: /snapshot [create|restore <id>|prune])

commands.name: /snap
commands.description: Create or restore state snapshots of Hermes config/state (alias for /snapshot)

commands.name: /stop
commands.description: Kill all running background processes

commands.name: /bg
commands.description: Run a prompt in a separate background session (usage: /bg <prompt>)

commands.name: /btw
commands.description: Ask a side question about the current conversation without interrupting it (usage: /btw <question>)

commands.name: /agents
commands.description: Show active agents and running tasks

commands.name: /tasks
commands.description: Show active agents and running tasks (alias for /agents)

commands.name: /journey
commands.description: Open the learning journey timeline (usage: /journey [list|delete <id>|edit <id>])

commands.name: /learning
commands.description: Open the learning journey timeline (alias for /journey)

commands.name: /memory-graph
commands.description: Open the learning journey timeline (alias for /journey)

commands.name: /queue
commands.description: Queue a prompt for the next turn, or list/edit/rm/move/clear queued prompts (usage: /queue [<prompt>|list|edit N <prompt>|rm N|move A B|clear])

commands.name: /q
commands.description: Queue a prompt for the next turn, or list/edit/rm/move/clear queued prompts (alias for /queue)

commands.name: /steer
commands.description: Inject a message after the next tool call without interrupting (usage: /steer <prompt>)

commands.name: /goal
commands.description: Set a standing goal Hermes works on across turns until achieved (usage: /goal [text | draft <text> | show | gate add <cmd> | pause | resume | clear | status | wait <pid> | unwait])

commands.name: /heartbeat
commands.description: Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle (usage: /heartbeat [every <interval> <prompt> | status | pause | resume | clear])

commands.name: /hb
commands.description: Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle (alias for /heartbeat)

commands.name: /refine
commands.description: Review this conversation now and save lessons to memory/skills (usage: /refine [focus instructions])

commands.name: /review
commands.description: Spawn an independent subagent to review the work just discussed (PR, code, docs) (usage: /review [review instructions])

commands.name: /loop
commands.description: Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session (usage: /loop [interval] <prompt> [--times N] [--until <condition>] | status | pause | resume | stop)

commands.name: /proactive
commands.description: Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session (alias for /loop)

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Write a markdown implementation plan to .hermes/plans/ without executing anything (usage: /plan [task])

commands.name: /moa
commands.description: Run one prompt through the default Mixture of Agents preset, then restore your model (usage: /moa <prompt>)

commands.name: /subgoal
commands.description: Add or manage extra criteria on the active goal (usage: /subgoal [text | remove N | clear])

commands.name: /status
commands.description: Show session, model, token, and context info

commands.name: /egress
commands.description: Show Docker egress proxy status (usage: /egress [status])

commands.name: /context
commands.description: Show detailed context window view with usage gauge, category breakdown, compression stats, and throughput (usage: /context [all])

commands.name: /ctx
commands.description: Show detailed context window view with usage gauge, category breakdown, compression stats, and throughput (alias for /context)

commands.name: /resume
commands.description: Resume a previously-named session (usage: /resume [name])

commands.name: /sessions
commands.description: Browse and resume previous sessions

commands.name: /export
commands.description: Export a profile (config, skills, theme) to a shareable archive (usage: /export [profile] [-o output.tar.gz])

commands.name: /import
commands.description: Import a shared profile archive as a new profile (usage: /import <archive.tar.gz> [--name <name>])

commands.name: /config
commands.description: Show current configuration

commands.name: /model
commands.description: Switch model (session-scoped; --global to persist) (usage: /model [model] [--provider name] [--reasoning level] [--global|--session] [--refresh])

commands.name: /codex-runtime
commands.description: Toggle codex app-server runtime for OpenAI/Codex models (usage: /codex-runtime [auto|codex_app_server])

commands.name: /codex_runtime
commands.description: Toggle codex app-server runtime for OpenAI/Codex models (alias for /codex-runtime)

commands.name: /personality
commands.description: Set a predefined personality (usage: /personality [name])

commands.name: /statusbar
commands.description: Toggle the context/model status bar
commands.disabledReason: Terminal status bar; the WebUI shows model, reasoning and context under the composer.

commands.name: /sb
commands.description: Toggle the context/model status bar (alias for /statusbar)
commands.disabledReason: Terminal status bar; the WebUI shows model, reasoning and context under the composer.

commands.name: /battery
commands.description: Toggle a color-coded battery indicator in the status bar (usage: /battery [on|off|status])
commands.disabledReason: Reports the battery of the machine running the terminal app.

commands.name: /timestamps
commands.description: Toggle [HH:MM] timestamps on messages and /history (usage: /timestamps [on|off|status])
commands.disabledReason: Terminal timestamps; the WebUI shows the time on hover under each message.

commands.name: /ts
commands.description: Toggle [HH:MM] timestamps on messages and /history (alias for /timestamps)
commands.disabledReason: Terminal timestamps; the WebUI shows the time on hover under each message.

commands.name: /verbose
commands.description: Cycle tool progress display: off -> new -> all -> verbose

commands.name: /focus
commands.description: Toggle focus view — show only your prompt and the final response (usage: /focus [on|off|status])

commands.name: /footer
commands.description: Toggle gateway runtime-metadata footer on final replies (usage: /footer [on|off|status])
commands.disabledReason: Terminal footer layout; not used by the WebUI.

commands.name: /yolo
commands.description: Toggle YOLO mode (skip all dangerous command approvals)

commands.name: /approvals
commands.description: Show or set the persistent dangerous-command approval mode (usage: /approvals [manual|smart|off])

commands.name: /reasoning
commands.description: Manage reasoning effort and display (usage: /reasoning [level|show|hide|full|clamp] [--global])

commands.name: /fast
commands.description: Fast mode — OpenAI Priority Processing / Anthropic Fast Mode (normal/fast/auto/cold) (usage: /fast [normal|fast|auto|cold|status] [--global])

commands.name: /skin
commands.description: Show or change the display skin/theme (usage: /skin [name])

commands.name: /indicator
commands.description: Pick the TUI busy-indicator style (usage: /indicator [ascii|emoji|kaomoji|unicode])
commands.disabledReason: Terminal busy indicator style; the WebUI has its own.

commands.name: /voice
commands.description: Toggle voice mode (usage: /voice [on|off|tts|status])

commands.name: /wake
commands.description: Toggle the 'Hey Hermes' wake word listener (usage: /wake [on|off|status])
commands.disabledReason: Wake word needs the desktop app microphone loop.

commands.name: /busy
commands.description: Control how messages behave while Hermes is working (usage: /busy [queue|steer|interrupt|status])

commands.name: /whoami
commands.description: Show your slash command access (admin / user)

commands.name: /profile
commands.description: Show active profile name and home directory

commands.name: /diff
commands.description: Show git changes in the working directory (usage: /diff [staged|all|session] [--stat] [path...])

commands.name: /help
commands.description: Show available commands (/help skills lists skill commands, /help <text> filters) (usage: /help [skills|<filter>])

commands.name: /palette
commands.description: Open the fuzzy command palette (also Ctrl+P)

commands.name: /usage
commands.description: Show token usage and rate limits; `reset` redeems a banked Codex limit reset (usage: /usage [reset [--force]])

commands.name: /subscription
commands.description: View your Nous plan and change it in the browser

commands.name: /upgrade
commands.description: View your Nous plan and change it in the browser (alias for /subscription)

commands.name: /login
commands.description: Sign in with a Nous account (keeps your connectors)

commands.name: /topup
commands.description: Show your Nous balance and manage billing on the portal

commands.name: /insights
commands.description: Show usage insights and analytics (usage: /insights [days])

commands.name: /platforms
commands.description: Show gateway/messaging platform status

commands.name: /gateway
commands.description: Show gateway/messaging platform status (alias for /platforms)

commands.name: /copy
commands.description: Copy the last assistant response to clipboard (usage: /copy [number])

commands.name: /paste
commands.description: Attach clipboard image from your clipboard

commands.name: /image
commands.description: Attach a local image file for your next prompt (usage: /image <path>)

commands.name: /update
commands.description: Update Hermes Agent to the latest version

commands.name: /version
commands.description: Show Hermes Agent version

commands.name: /v
commands.description: Show Hermes Agent version (alias for /version)

commands.name: /debug
commands.description: Upload debug report (system info + logs) and get shareable links (usage: /debug [nous|local])

commands.name: /tools
commands.description: Manage tools: /tools [list|disable|enable] [name...] (usage: /tools [list|disable|enable] [name...])

commands.name: /toolsets
commands.description: List available toolsets

commands.name: /skills
commands.description: Search, install, inspect, or manage skills

commands.name: /memory
commands.description: Review pending memory writes / toggle the approval gate (usage: /memory [pending|approve|reject|approval] [id|on|off])

commands.name: /bundles
commands.description: List skill bundles (aliases /<name> for multiple skills)

commands.name: /pet
commands.description: Toggle or adopt a petdex mascot (/pet, /pet list, /pet <slug>) (usage: /pet [toggle|list|scale <n>|<slug>])

commands.name: /hatch
commands.description: Generate a new petdex pet from a description (usage: /hatch [description])

commands.name: /generate-pet
commands.description: Generate a new petdex pet from a description (alias for /hatch)

commands.name: /learn
commands.description: Learn a reusable skill from anything you describe (dirs, URLs, this chat, notes) (usage: /learn <what to learn from>)

commands.name: /init
commands.description: Generate or update AGENTS.md project instructions from a repo scan (usage: /init [notes])

commands.name: /cron
commands.description: Manage scheduled tasks (usage: /cron [subcommand])

commands.name: /suggestions
commands.description: Review suggested automations (accept/dismiss) (usage: /suggestions [accept|dismiss N | catalog])

commands.name: /suggest
commands.description: Review suggested automations (accept/dismiss) (alias for /suggestions)

commands.name: /blueprint
commands.description: Set up an automation from a blueprint template (usage: /blueprint [name] [slot=value ...])

commands.name: /bp
commands.description: Set up an automation from a blueprint template (alias for /blueprint)

commands.name: /curator
commands.description: Background skill maintenance (status, run, pin, archive, list-archived) (usage: /curator [subcommand])

commands.name: /kanban
commands.description: Multi-profile collaboration board (tasks, links, comments) (usage: /kanban [subcommand])

commands.name: /reload
commands.description: Reload .env variables into the running session

commands.name: /reload-mcp
commands.description: Reload MCP servers from config

commands.name: /reload_mcp
commands.description: Reload MCP servers from config (alias for /reload-mcp)

commands.name: /reload-skills
commands.description: Re-scan ~/.hermes/skills/ for newly installed or removed skills

commands.name: /reload_skills
commands.description: Re-scan ~/.hermes/skills/ for newly installed or removed skills (alias for /reload-skills)

commands.name: /browser
commands.description: Connect browser tools to your live Chromium-family browser via CDP, or switch to Browser Use mode (usage: /browser [connect|disconnect|status|use])

commands.name: /plugins
commands.description: List installed plugins and their status

commands.description: Exit the CLI (use --delete to also remove session history) (usage: /quit [--delete])

commands.name: /exit
